bio_50_words: Dr. Salma Khairallah directs the Applied Health Sciences Technology programs at East Port Said National University, including Medical Laboratory Technology and Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology. She holds a PhD in Biochemistry from Port Said University's Faculty of Science, where she previously directed the Biochemistry and Microbiology Program.
